subject.title: Unbounded memory growth in model-pricing-cache.ts leads to heap exhaustion (OOM)

question: Which linked cache-cap implementation should become the canonical fix for this gateway model-pricing cache issue?
rationale: Both linked PRs use closing syntax for this issue and target the same state boundary, but they differ in eviction semantics and neither has merged with real behavior proof.

options.title: Continue the recency-aware candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101714 as the canonical path after the contributor adds real behavior proof and maintainers confirm the 4096-entry cap.

options.title: Revise the smaller cap candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101713 only if it is updated to preserve active or recently used pricing rows and adds proof for the retained/evicted behavior.

options.title: Ask for consolidation
options.body: Have the two contributors converge on one branch so review, proof, and merge risk are not split across competing fixes.

recommendation.title: Continue the recency-aware candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101714 as the canonical path after the contributor adds real behavior proof and maintainers confirm the 4096-entry cap.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cache-state lines are attributed to this recent current-line contributor, making them the best available routing owner for choosing the intended cache policy.
